integrity: The unrestricted result has a self-contained induction proof and a reproducible standard-library finite checker. Originality has residual risk from older modal-algebra literature; independent mathematical and historical evaluation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite ordinal sums of antichains with reflexive reachability, not total preorders with nontrivial clusters or arbitrary finite posets. Finite computation is corroboration, not proof.
title: Singleton-frontier law for modal generators on finite weak orders
